name: Botify
description_en:
Botify connects website crawls, server/CDN logs, Search Console and optional analytics with technical search analysis, AI visibility and deployment tools. Its current site groups this into AI Readiness, AI Visibility and AI Activation. SiteCrawler, LogAnalyzer, campaigns and PageWorkers remain different workflows with different prerequisites and permissions.

A useful evaluation starts with one site section: validate crawl and log coverage, join comparable periods, select a small AI prompt panel and inspect a proposed optimization before deployment. Botify can also serve data to external AI clients through MCP. Public documents support these capabilities, but the vendor’s speed, revenue and recommendation claims were not independently measured; no crawl, data integration, campaign or live change was executed.
description_zh:
Botify 将网站抓取、服务器／CDN 日志、Search Console 及可选分析与技术搜索分析、AI 可见性及部署工具连接。当前官网分为 AI Readiness、AI Visibility 及 AI Activation。SiteCrawler、LogAnalyzer、活动及 PageWorkers 仍是不同流程，各有前提及权限。

适合评估的是一个站点部分：验证抓取及日志覆盖、连接可比时间段、选小型 AI 提示词面板，部署前查看拟议优化。Botify 也可经 MCP 向外部 AI 客户端提供数据。公开文档支持这些能力，但供应商速度、收入及推荐主张未独立测量，本研究未抓取、集成数据、运行活动或修改线上。

core_features.explanation_en: SiteCrawler snapshots can be joined with integrated log observations.
core_features.explanation_zh: SiteCrawler 快照可与集成日志观察连接。

core_features.explanation_en: Test URL rules before explicitly saving and applying a segmentation version.
core_features.explanation_zh: 明确保存并应用版本前测试 URL 规则。

core_features.explanation_en: Monitor selected prompt/country/platform combinations within an answer allocation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在回答配额内监控提示词／国家／平台组合。

core_features.explanation_en: Preview, deploy, pause or archive a scoped optimization with separate permissions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以独立权限预览、部署、暂停或归档限定优化。

en: Investigate a site section using validated crawl, log and GSC scope.
Monitor a fixed AI panel with an explicit country/platform answer budget.
Preview and evaluate a scoped PageWorkers hypothesis before broader rollout.
zh: 按已验证抓取、日志及 GSC 范围调查站点部分。
按明确国家／平台回答预算监控固定 AI 面板。
大范围上线前预览并评估限定 PageWorkers 假说。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

specific_roles.zh: 企业技术 SEO 负责人

steps.zh: 记录范围并验证首个已完成抓取。

steps.zh: 验证日志覆盖及真实源时间段。

steps.en: Test segment rules before saving and recomputing history.

steps.zh: 日更前查回答配额及活动状态。

steps.en: Preview a scoped draft and confirm live-deployment permissions.

items.en: Daily frequency can pause all campaigns and requires manual reactivation after resizing.
items.zh: 日更可暂停全部活动，调容量后需手动恢复。

items.zh: 排除提示词会移除其组合及活动历史。

items.zh: 当前归档优化不可恢复。

items.en: Cross-project assistant totals can include uneven or missing source data.
items.zh: 跨项目代理总数可能含不均或缺失源数据。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The June plan guide names Essential, Accelerate, Growth, Pro and Enterprise, with options and view-only entitlements rather than public amounts. Accelerate marks many tools view-only; PageWorkers, SpeedWorkers and SmartLink eligibility varies. AI Visibility is documented as an option. The public pricing URL redirects to a demo request, so subscription amount, currency, billing period, tax, trial, refund and cancellation terms remain unknown. MCP has no separate access fee but consumes shared agent credits. No numeric or normalized quote inferred.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 六月套餐指南列 Essential、Accelerate、Growth、Pro 及 Enterprise，以可选／只读权益而非公开金额展示。Accelerate 多工具只读，PageWorkers、SpeedWorkers 及 SmartLink 资格不同，AI Visibility 文档列为可选。公开 pricing URL 跳转演示申请，因此订阅金额、币种、周期、税、试用、退款及取消条件未知。MCP 无单独接入费，但耗共享代理积分。不推数字或标准化报价。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A crawl is defined by its starts, scope and limits
sections.title_zh: 抓取由起点、范围及上限定义
sections.en: Start URLs, allowed domains/protocols, exclusions, device configuration, depth and analyzed-URL limits determine coverage. To inspect only an imported URL list, the settings guide specifies depth zero. Multiple starts all appear at depth zero, affecting architectural interpretation. Scheduling uses the chosen timezone, but the guide says crawl displays use Central European time. Settings also enforce URL/depth/subscription limits, despite current marketing saying no crawl-budget limits. Editorial first crawl: record the effective configuration and compare equivalent crawls before interpreting New or Disappeared URLs as website additions or deletions. A missing URL may simply lie outside the chosen traversal.
sections.zh: 起始 URL、允许域／协议、排除、设备、深度及分析 URL 上限决定覆盖。设置指南规定仅检查导入列表时设零深度，多个起点均记零深度，会影响架构解读。计划用所选时区，但指南称抓取显示中欧时间。设置还执行 URL／深度／订阅限制，与当前营销“不限抓取预算”存在差异。编辑首次抓取：记录有效配置，比较等价抓取，不能直接将 New／Disappeared 视网站增删；缺 URL 可能只是遍历范围外。

sections.title_en: A delivered log file is not yet an ingested dataset
sections.title_zh: 日志文件已交付不等于数据已摄取
sections.en: Log integration requires the right CDN/origin coverage, request dates, full URLs, status, user-agent and appropriate referral fields. Unique file paths must not overwrite earlier deposits. Botify validates format and fields, then asks the customer to validate volumes and URL/domain scope in the first dashboard. Logfiles Explorer distinguishes discovered, parsed and ingested files and shows UTC activity ranges. Editorial missing-bot investigation: inspect the relevant file, ingestion status and enabled bot filter before treating zero activity as crawler absence. A marketing crawler-access chart depends on complete source logging, not simply on an uploaded filename.
sections.zh: 日志集成需正确 CDN／源站覆盖、请求日期、完整 URL、状态、user-agent 及适当引荐字段，唯一文件路径不能覆盖旧存入。Botify 核格式／字段，再要求客户核首仪表盘数量及 URL／域范围。Logfiles Explorer 区分发现、解析及摄取，并显示 UTC 活动范围。编辑缺机器人调查：将零活动视作爬虫缺席前查相关文件、摄取状态及启用机器人筛选。营销爬虫访问图依完整源日志，不仅是已上传文件名。

sections.title_en: Joined sources have different clocks and history
sections.title_zh: 连接的源有不同时间线及历史
sections.en: Crawl reports use selected snapshots; integrated logs and GSC arrive on their own schedules. The periods guide describes a two-to-three-day GSC retrieval delay and sixteen-month import for standard integration, with no historical import for Bulk Data Export. Analytics and field CWV use different windows. The Data source availability grid shows actual overlap. Explorer bookmarks retain filters/columns but not the period; a full report URL can preserve it. Editorial stakeholder report: state source windows and the chosen crawl, then inspect overlap before comparing. Matching chart labels does not establish identical observation dates or conversion definitions.
sections.zh: 抓取报告用所选快照，集成日志及 GSC 按各自日程到达。时间段指南列 GSC 获取延迟二至三天、标准集成导十六个月历史，Bulk Data Export 不导历史；分析及现场 CWV 窗口另异。Data source availability 表显示真实重叠。Explorer 书签留筛选／列，不留时间段，完整报告 URL 可保留。编辑利益相关方报告：说明源窗口及选定抓取，比较前查重叠；图标签相同不能确定观察日期或转化定义一致。

sections.en: The Segment Editor supports rules, a sample checker, previews and version history. An orange dot marks unsaved changes; checking a sample does not activate them. Save this configuration as active commits the version, after which selected previous analyses can be recomputed. #nomatch URLs failed to enter a defined group; rule order and parent/child selection matter. The guide limits configuration to twenty segments and three thousand lines. Editorial category comparison: test representative URL variants, inspect unmatched/duplicate groups and record the active version before attributing a historical shift to site behavior. A changed classification can change the report without changing the website.
sections.zh: Segment Editor 提供规则、样本检查、预览及版本历史。橙点为未保存，样本检查不激活；Save this configuration as active 保存活动版，之后可重算选定旧分析。#nomatch 表示未进入定义组，规则顺序及父／子选择有影响。指南限二十个 segment、三千行。编辑类别比较：测代表 URL 变体、审未匹配／重复组并记活动版本，不能直接归因历史变化于网站行为。分类变更可在网站未变时改报告。

sections.title_en: Generated prompts and a customer-researched CSV are different panels
sections.title_zh: 生成提示词与客户研究 CSV 是不同面板
sections.en: AI Visibility campaigns can use top GSC keywords, website categories or CSV prompts. CSV is the documented way to specify the exact prompts before running; it requires the prompts header. A prompt across two platforms produces two answers before other dimensions or repeated runs. Allocation is shared across campaigns, and deleting a campaign is permanent. The latest FAQ describes logged-out public-site collection, while the marketing page still describes hybrid API collection with memory/context. Editorial panel design: preserve the source list, country and platform and treat AI-generated questions as hypotheses rather than measured customer demand. The collection-method conflict was not resolved through an executed test.
sections.zh: AI Visibility 活动可用 GSC 顶词、网站类别或 CSV 提示词，CSV 是文档中运行前指定准确词的方式，需 prompts 表头。一个词跨两个平台先产生两个回答，另有其他维度及重复运行。配额跨活动共享，删活动永久。最新 FAQ 描述未登录公开网页采集，营销页仍写混合 API 及记忆／上下文。编辑面板设计：保留源列表、国家及平台，将 AI 生成问题视作假说，不是实测客户需求；未执行测试解决采集方法冲突。

sections.title_en: Switching to daily can deactivate every campaign
sections.title_zh: 切日更可使全部活动停用
sections.en: Frequency applies to the whole project, not individual campaigns. Daily uses the same weekly answer allocation over seven runs, leaving one seventh as many answers per batch. If existing allocations exceed that smaller budget, switching deactivates all campaigns. Reducing scope or returning to weekly does not reactivate them automatically; explicit activation is needed. The guide recommends new campaigns to preserve the old weekly series, and warns that daily’s smaller samples vary more. Editorial change: calculate the new allocation first, keep the intended comparison panel and inspect both campaign status and next run after switching. More frequent checks do not automatically produce a comparable trend.
sections.zh: 频率适用整个项目，不能逐活动不同。日更将同一周回答配额分七次，每批仅七分之一；已有分配超新预算时，切换会停用全部活动。缩范围或回周更不会自动恢复，需明确启用。指南建议新建活动以保留旧周更序列，并提醒日更小样本波动更大。编辑变更：先算新配额、保留目标比较面板，切后查活动状态及下次运行。加频不能自动形成可比趋势。

sections.title_en: Mention, citation and referral are separate observations
sections.title_zh: 提及、引用及引荐是独立观察
sections.en: The Answers report retains prompt, country, platform, answer date and full response; sentiment and intent are LLM classifications. Citations are clickable domain/URL links, while mentions can name a brand without a link. Citation rate uses the proportion of collected responses containing the brand-domain link, not all AI conversations. The answer guide says only response-body links are retrieved, not every source link. Excluding an irrelevant prompt removes all platform/country combinations and its campaign history. Editorial readout: retain the original response and panel definition before cleanup, distinguish linked visibility from measured referrals and avoid treating a missing citation as global non-discovery.
sections.zh: Answers 保留词、国家、平台、回答日期及全文，情感／意图由 LLM 分类。引用是可点击域／URL，提及可仅有品牌名。引用率以采集回答中含品牌域链接比例计算，不是全部 AI 对话。回答指南称仅取正文链接，不取所有来源链接。排除无关词会移除全部平台／国家组合及活动历史。编辑读数：清理前保留原回答及面板定义，区分带链接可见性及实测引荐，不能将缺引用视全球未发现。

sections.title_en: Preview is available before a live optimization
sections.en: PageWorkers separates Draft, Live and Paused. Preview works in any status for a matching URL and shows intended appearance, not proof that deployment is active. Pausing a Live optimization stops its effect until explicitly activated; activation makes it live again. Archiving stops delivery and cannot currently be recovered. The Optimized URLs list can be searched and exported. Editorial rollout: inspect a representative URL, scope and effective publishing role before deployment, then verify actual output. Use Pause when a reversible hold is intended; treating Archive as an ordinary recoverable folder would contradict the guide. No site changes were made.
sections.zh: PageWorkers 区分 Draft、Live 及 Paused。任意状态可对匹配 URL 预览，展示预期外观，不证明部署已生效。暂停 Live 停止作用直到明确启用，再启用恢复上线；归档停投递且当前不可恢复。Optimized URLs 可搜及导出。编辑上线：部署前审代表 URL、范围及有效发布角色，之后查真实输出。需可逆暂缓时用 Pause，不能将 Archive 当普通可恢复目录。本研究未改网站。

sections.title_en: SEO split testing assigns groups of pages
sections.title_zh: SEO 分流测试分配的是页面组
sections.en: PageWorkers split tests compare randomly assigned variant/control page groups, rather than alternate versions shown to individual visitors. The overview calls for enough same-template pages and traffic, one concurrent test per template, and a focused hypothesis. Its method excludes the highest-click five percent of pages. Pausing does not pause the elapsed-day counter; editing resets reporting. Disabling a split test for full-scope rollout deletes its split-test report. Editorial experiment: retain the original group definition and results before changing or ending it, inspect imbalance and seasonality, and keep an inconclusive result uncertain. A running counter is not evidence of uninterrupted exposure or positive impact.
sections.zh: PageWorkers 比随机分配的变体／对照页面组，不是向访客展示同页不同版。概览要求足够同模板页面及流量、每模板同时一个测试及聚焦假说，方法排除点击最高的百分之五页面。暂停不停累计天数，编辑重置报告；关闭分流改全范围上线会删除分流报告。编辑实验：修改／结束前保留原组定义及结果，查不平衡及季节性，无法定论应保持不确定。计数仍跑不证明连续曝光或正效果。

sections.title_en: Team roles separate analysis from live deployment
sections.title_zh: 团队角色区分分析及线上部署
sections.en: Organizations contain projects and teams. A team’s role applies to its members, and a person or project can belong to several teams. Viewer reads reports; Editor can create optimizations but not start crawls; Admin adds crawl/settings access; among listed team roles, only Super Admin deploys live settings/optimizations. Owners manage team access. Legacy project assignments can remain alongside teams. Editorial collaboration: inspect every applicable team and legacy assignment before assuming a nominal role describes effective access. Removing a person from one team may not settle access through another route, and revoking project access does not delete their Botify account.
sections.zh: 组织含项目及团队，团队角色适用成员，人及项目可属多个团队。Viewer 读报告，Editor 可建优化但不能启动抓取，Admin 增抓取／设置，所列团队角色中仅 Super Admin 可部署线上设置／优化。Owner 管团队访问，旧项目授权可与团队并存。编辑协作：审全部适用团队及旧授权，不能假设名义角色就是有效访问；从一个团队移除不确定其他路径，撤项目访问不删 Botify 账户。

sections.title_en: MCP can span accessible projects and create a draft
sections.title_zh: MCP 可跨可访问项目并创建草稿
sections.en: MCP supports portfolio questions across accessible projects, unlike project-local Assist. Unqualified queries may include ad-hoc or abandoned projects with uneven data. Current connection and MCP FAQ pages require OAuth only, conflicting with an AI Visibility FAQ line accepting an API key. Nearly all agents are read-only; the PageWorkers agent can create a permitted draft but launch remains in its interface. Stored snapshots and live search answers have different reproducibility. Editorial assistant request: name projects, dimensions and dates, check prerequisites and ask which data was missing. A confident answer or annotation correlation does not establish completeness or causal impact.
sections.zh: MCP 可跨获授项目问组合问题，Assist 则在单项目。未限定查询可纳入数据配置不同的临时／废弃项目。当前连接及 MCP FAQ 规定仅 OAuth，与 AI Visibility FAQ 接受 API key 的一句冲突。几乎全部代理只读，PageWorkers 代理可按权限建草稿，但启动仍需在其界面。存储快照及实时搜索回答可重复性不同。编辑请求：明确项目、维度及日期，核前提并问缺哪些数据。自信回答或注释相关不能确定完整性或因果效果。

sections.title_en: Included MCP does not mean unlimited agents or uniform history
sections.title_zh: 包含 MCP 不代表不限代理或统一历史
sections.en: Agent calls share project credits across MCP, Assist and API, with cost based on task complexity. The consumption page shows monthly/daily allowances; after a threshold the guide describes a short grace period and an account-manager warning, not unlimited use. Usage queries themselves are free. Subscription history differs by source: crawl/trended data retains selected snapshots over twenty-four months, raw HTML only one to six months by tier, and log/keyword retention differs again. Editorial procurement: confirm the contracted allowances and retained artifacts needed for a later comparison. A two-year chart entitlement is not two years of every raw crawl or HTML response.
sections.zh: 代理调用跨 MCP、Assist 及 API 共用项目积分，按任务复杂度计。消耗页显示月／日配额，超阈值指南列短暂宽限及账户经理提醒，不是不限制；查用量本身免费。历史随源异：抓取／趋势二十四个月保留选定快照，原 HTML 按档仅一至六个月，日志／词历史又不同。编辑采购：核合同额度及以后比较需保留的产物。两年图表权益不等于每次原抓取或 HTML 都保留两年。

seo.title_en: Botify: crawl evidence, AI campaign budgets and PageWorkers states
seo.title_zh: Botify：抓取证据、AI 活动预算及 PageWorkers 状态
seo.description_en: Review Botify data-source periods, log validation, segmentation, daily AI tracking, live optimization controls and MCP scope.
seo.description_zh: 核 Botify 源时间段、日志验证、分群、AI 日更、线上优化控制及 MCP 范围。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Botify enterprise SEO and AI visibility operations
